h1: Accept crypto tips as a creator with your personal tip page
subheading: Get your own dynopay.com/@handle page where fans support you in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and 12+ other cryptos—paid directly to your wallet.
intro_paragraph: Most platforms hold your tips in their account and pay you later. Dynopay works differently: every tip goes straight to your own crypto wallet, and you keep custody the entire time. Your personal tip page at dynopay.com/@handle accepts 15+ cryptocurrencies, fans pay in one tap without creating an account, and you're live in under 10 minutes. The first payment is completely free, then fees start at 1.5% and drop to 0.5% as your volume grows.

features.title: Tips straight to your wallet
features.description: Every crypto tip lands directly in the wallet you control. Dynopay never holds your funds, so you have full custody and can move your crypto whenever you want.

features.title: Your own branded tip page
features.description: Claim your dynopay.com/@handle and share one link everywhere. Fans pay in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDT, or 11+ other cryptos without signing up or installing anything.

features.title: Fees drop as you grow
features.description: Your first payment is free. After that, fees start at 1.5% and automatically fall to 0.5% based on your volume. No monthly charges, no setup costs, no chargebacks.

how_it_works: Sign up with your email, create your creator profile, and claim your custom @handle at dynopay.com.
Add your crypto wallet address once—Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, or any chain you prefer for payouts.
Share your dynopay.com/@handle link in your bio, stream overlays, or posts. Fans tip you in seconds.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can I accept as tips?
faqs.answer: You can accept 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Dogecoin, Litecoin, XRP, Tron, Polygon, and stablecoins like USDT and USDC across multiple networks. Fans choose which crypto to send, and you receive it directly in your wallet.

faqs.question: Do I need to create a wallet for each cryptocurrency?
faqs.answer: No. You add one payout wallet address per cryptocurrency you want to support. For example, add one Ethereum address to receive ETH, USDT, USDC, and RLUSD on Ethereum. Tips in that crypto go straight to the wallet you provided.

faqs.question: How much does Dynopay charge for crypto tips?
faqs.answer: Your first payment is completely free. After that, fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per tip and automatically drop to as low as 0.5% as your volume grows. There are no monthly fees, setup costs, or hidden charges.

faqs.question: Do my fans need to sign up or install anything?
faqs.answer: No. Fans visit your dynopay.com/@handle page, choose their crypto, and send the tip from their existing wallet. They don't create an account—at most they can leave an optional email for a receipt. Payment takes seconds.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting crypto tips?
faqs.answer: Under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, claim your @handle, and add your wallet address. Your personal tip page goes live immediately and you can share the link anywhere your community gathers.

cta_headline: Claim your tip page and go live today
cta_body: Sign up in two minutes, add your wallet, and start accepting crypto tips. Your first payment is free, no monthly fees ever.
